<!-- definition-1: body_md -->
For any pair of vectors $\bm{\ell}, \bm{u} \in \mathbb{R}^n$ satisfying $\bm{\ell}^0\leq\bm{\ell}\leq\bm{u}\leq\bm{u}^0$, we call Problem \eqref{eqn:p} with the additional constraints $\bm{\ell}\leq \bm{x} \leq \bm{u}$
a \emph{node} and denote it $\mathcal{P}(\bm{\ell}, \bm{u})$.
<!-- end definition-1 -->
